content: Chromodomain-helicase-DNA-binding protein 1 (CHD1) is an enzyme encoded by the CHD1 gene in humans. Proteins in the CHD family are defined by the presence of chromo domains, which are chromatin organization modifier domains, as well as SNF2-related helicase/ATPase domains. CHD genes are thought to influence gene expression by modifying chromatin structure, thereby altering the accessibility of the transcriptional machinery to its chromosomal DNA template. CHD1 has been demonstrated to interact with Nuclear receptor co-repressor 1.
